title: Prime Minister highlights the strong contribution of teachers on Teachers' Day
subtitle: PM pays homage to Dr. S. Radhakrishnan
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today highlighted that Teachers' Day is about appreciating the strong contribution of teachers to society. He added that it is also a day to pay homage to Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.
Furthermore, the Prime Minister shared glimpses of the interactions that took place when the National Teachers' Awards winners were invited to 7, Lok Kalyan Marg (LKM) yesterday.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"#TeachersDay is about appreciating the strong contribution of teachers to our society. It is also a day to pay homage to Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.
Here is what happened when the National Teachers' Awards winners were invited to 7, LKM yesterday…."
